facts.fact: INS published a bulletin on social protection combining RGPH 2024 census results with CNSS, CNRPS, CNAM and Amen Social scheme records, giving 2.43 million occupied people effectively covered (66.3% of 3.66 million occupied aged 18+) and 82.1% health coverage.
